baseline_rainfall.description: Naive alert solely based on local precipitation gauge readings.
baseline_rainfall.notes: Misses downhill valley flash-floods where rain falls only upstream.

baseline_noaa_ffg.description: Operational NWS regional runoff threshold comparison.
baseline_noaa_ffg.notes: Coarse basin-scale guidance; known weak skill scores in steep topography.

stage_1_tabular.description: LSTM sequence model over GHCNh precipitation, temperature, pressure, wind.
stage_1_tabular.notes: Ground observations only; lacks spatial storm cloud and terrain routing context.

stage_2_tabular_terrain.description: Fuses weather sequences with DEM elevation, slope, aspect, and flow accumulation.
stage_2_tabular_terrain.notes: Terrain features allow model to identify vulnerable steep slopes and drainage convergence.

stage_3_multimodal.description: Full multimodal fusion with GOES-16 ABI storm trajectories and explicit missing-frame masking.
stage_3_multimodal.notes: Satellite storm movies detect convective cloud top growth; missing-frame mask prevents noise.

stage_4_flow_routing.description: End-to-end warning pipeline combining multimodal AI with D8 hydrological downhill alert propagation.
stage_4_flow_routing.notes: Eliminates downhill blind spots; achieves highest CSI and POD by warning valley communities before water arrives.

ablation_circular_buffer.description: Alerts all stations within 25km radius regardless of terrain slope or watershed boundaries.
ablation_circular_buffer.notes: Suffers from high False Alarm Ratio (FAR) because it broadcasts indiscriminately to uphill peaks.
